safety_verdicts.content: The headache improves when the patient is lying down.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not state improvement when lying down; it only notes no postural variation / generally lying down.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether headache improves when lying down can indicate a positional component (e.g., low CSF pressure) and affects triage and follow-up advice. Omitting it may delay consideration of alternative headache etiologies but is unlikely to cause immediate harm in an otherwise uncomplicated presentation.

This is typically correctable with clarification and is unlikely to directly cause major harm on its own.
